SOC

Gestione degli Incidenti

A structured set of procedures used by security teams to address, manage, and resolve cybersecurity incidents, including containment, eradication, and recovery, following official frameworks such as NIST SP 800-61 and ISO/IEC 27035.

Questions and answers

What is Gestione degli Incidenti?

In this glossary, Gestione degli Incidenti refers to: A structured set of procedures used by security teams to address, manage, and resolve cybersecurity incidents, including containment, eradication, and recovery, following official frameworks such as NIST SP 800-61 and ISO/IEC 27035.

How is Gestione degli Incidenti used in cybersecurity?

In cybersecurity communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "I processi di gestione degli incidenti assicurano che, una volta rilevata un'intrusione, vengano adottati i passi appropriati per contenere, eradicare e ripristinare con il minimo impatto sul business."

Definition

A structured set of procedures used by security teams to address, manage, and resolve cybersecurity incidents, including containment, eradication, and recovery, following official frameworks such as NIST SP 800-61 and ISO/IEC 27035.

Operational example

Incident handling processes ensure that once an intrusion is detected, proper steps are taken to contain, eradicate, and recover with minimal business disruption.
